PRODUCT_INTENT_AMBIGUITY.description: User intent is ambiguous or admits materially different interpretations; proceeding would guess the product decision.
examples: conflicting requirements with no acceptance criteria
feature request open to incompatible readings

IRREVERSIBLE_REAL_DATA_ACTION.description: Irreversible deletion or mutation of real data with no reliable recovery path.

UNAUTHORIZED_PRODUCTION_ACTION.description: Destructive or mutating production action not explicitly authorized in the current request.

EXTERNAL_COST_OR_PURCHASE.description: Any payment, purchase, subscription, or usage that incurs external cost.

CREATE_ROTATE_REVOKE_CREDENTIAL.description: Creation, rotation, or revocation of credentials, secrets, or access tokens.

EXTERNAL_COMMUNICATION_AS_USER.description: Outbound communication sent externally in the user's name.
examples: post a public comment as the user

MATERIAL_SCOPE_EXPANSION.description: Expansion of the requested scope in a material way beyond the current objective.

POLICY_DENIED.description: Action explicitly denied by the applicable project, global, or environment policy.

REQUIRED_EXTERNAL_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE.description: Required external input (human, provider, or system) is unavailable and no authorized alternative exists.
examples: required external service stays down with no fallback

notes: Declarative contract only. Enforcement is wired in later phases; the kernel remains the authority. Unknown inputs fail closed to Denied.
